# Gio, patched for LeanTerm

This is Gio v0.10.3 (https://gioui.org, MIT or Unlicense, see LICENSE) with
the changes below; `go.mod` of LeanTerm replaces `gioui.org` with this
folder. The tests and testdata of the upstream module are left out.

Every change in an upstream file is marked with a `LeanTerm patch` comment;
the new files are `leanterm_*.go`, `os_*_leanterm.*` and
`wayland_xdg_activation.*` (generated by wayland-scanner, see go:generate in
`os_wayland_leanterm.go`).

| Change | Files |
|---|---|
| `app.FileDropEvent`: files dropped from other applications. X11: XDND (version 5, `text/uri-list`, `XdndActionCopy`). Wayland: the drag offers of `wl_data_device` with `text/uri-list`. During a drag the window gets pointer moves, so the program sees what is under the files. | `leanterm_patch.go`, `leanterm_uri.go`, `os_x11_leanterm.go`, `os_wayland_leanterm.go`, `window.go`, `os_x11.go`, `os_wayland.go` |
| `app.AppID(id)`: the application id of one window (Wayland `app_id`, X11 `WM_CLASS`) instead of the process-wide `app.ID`, so that LeanEdit's window in the LeanTerm process is LeanEdit's in the taskbar. | `leanterm_patch.go`, `os.go`, `os_x11.go`, `os_wayland.go` |
| `app.Icon(img)`: the window icon on X11 (`_NET_WM_ICON`); X11 windows also get `_NET_WM_PID`. | `leanterm_patch.go`, `os_x11_leanterm.go` |
| `Window.Activate(token)`: raise and focus a window with the desktop's activation token: `xdg_activation_v1` on Wayland (Gio's `ActionRaise` does nothing there), `_NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW` from a pager plus the end of the startup notification on X11, `ActionRaise` elsewhere. | `leanterm_patch.go`, `os_wayland_leanterm.*`, `os_x11_leanterm.go`, `os_wayland.go` |

To update Gio: copy the new release over this folder (without tests), apply
the marked changes again and run `go generate` in `app` for the Wayland
protocol files.
